# Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle

# Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle. Run status: COMPLETED.

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The r10.5.0 hflush call alone cannot establish crash durability: Hadoop 3.3.6 defines hflush as visibility without a durability guarantee. The helper also closes the stream, so successful-close behavior must be assessed separately. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java · keywords: Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle · also: https://hadoop.apache.org/docs/r3.3.6/hadoop-project-dist/hadoop-common/filesystem/outputstream.html

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Hadoop 3.3.6 S3A does not publish buffered writes through hflush/hsync; publication occurs at close. Its downgrade-syncable-exceptions setting controls warning versus UnsupportedOperationException, not whether flushing persists data. This scopes any durability inference from the helper’s hflush. (low confidence) — https://hadoop.apache.org/docs/r3.3.6/hadoop-aws/tools/hadoop-aws/troubleshooting_s3a.html

## Facts and statements

- [statement] In r10.5.0, initialOffset checks the supplied path. If it exists, it reads all bytes, decodes UTF-8 and calls MongoOffset.fromJson; otherwise it writes the configured initial offset. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java
- [statement] In r10.5.0, updateOffset calls fs.create(path, true), writes UTF-8 offset.json(), calls hflush(), and closes through try-with-resources. No temporary-path rename appears. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java
- [statement] The r10.5.0 helper wraps I/O failures in ConfigException. Its existing-file branch has no fallback that replaces unreadable JSON with the configured starting offset. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java
- [statement] In r10.5.0, MongoScan forwards its checkpointLocation argument unchanged to the selected streaming implementation. Both implementations construct MongoOffsetStore, delegate initialOffset(), and call updateOffset(end) from commit(); stop() only logs. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoScan.java · keywords: Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoContinuousStream.java, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoMicroBatchStream.java
- [statement] In r10.5.0, filesystem selection uses the checkpoint URI and SparkHadoopUtils. That utility obtains SparkContext.hadoopConfiguration() and overlays SparkConf entries beginning with fs.; effective filesystem credentials and flush settings therefore matter. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java · keywords: Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/utils/SparkHadoopUtils.java
- [statement] For an ABFS deployment, inspect fs.azure.enable.flush: Hadoop 3.3.6 documents disabling it as making hflush/hsync no-ops. Microsoft separately documents the service distinction between intermediate flush and final close; these are not interchangeable lifecycle events. (medium confidence) — https://hadoop.apache.org/docs/r3.3.6/hadoop-azure/abfs.html · keywords: Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/datalakestoragegen2/path/update?view=rest-storageservices-datalakestoragegen2-2019-12-12
- [statement] A restart plan using Azure Data Lake storage must establish exclusive ownership of the offset path: Microsoft’s Path Update API, displayed as version 2023-08-03, does not support multiple clients concurrently writing one file. MongoOffsetStore supplies no locking protocol. (medium confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/datalakestoragegen2/path/update?view=rest-storageservices-datalakestoragegen2-2019-12-12 · keywords: Spark MongoOffsetStore load/save and checkpoint lifecycle · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/r10.5.0/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/MongoOffsetStore.java
